title: Bo AI | Your Personal Assistant
excerpt: Bo makes your life easier. Helping you stay organized, save time, live healthier, and answer your questions - all via text.
content_html:
⭐

Helping 100K+ save time

Bo makes your life easier. Helping you stay organized, save time, live healthier, and answer your questions—all via text.

20M+Messages Exchanged

USE CASES

Bo makes your life easier

Nutrition & Meals

HOW IT WORKS

Get started in 4 steps

STEP 1

Onboard

Tell Bo about your goals, body and lifestyle.

STEP 2

Text Bo

Send your first message — Bo replies in iMessage.

STEP 3

Connect integrations

Sync your favorite health and lifestyle apps via the Bo app.

STEP 4

Explore Skills

Explore Bo's capabilities to level up your health and lifestyle needs.

What to expect

A healthier and more productive lifestyle

Why Bo?

The Problem

✕

You find health and productivity overwhelming

✕

You need $1,000+/mo to afford an assistant

✕

You waste 1-2 hours daily tracking in apps

✕

You struggle to hit goals and can't stick to a plan

The Solution

✓

Bo helps make your life more convenient

✓

Bo is 1/100th the cost of an assistant

✓

Bo meets you where you already are

✓

Bo checks in on you and is available 24/7

WHAT REALLY MATTERS

Your Quality of Life

Without your health or your time, you can't:

Perform at your best in both sports and business

Focus on what matters and live your life in the present

Be the partner who shows up with energy and presence, not exhaustion

Make memories that matter when your body won't let you keep up

Be active with your kids without feeling like you're missing out

#LiveMore

Less Screens.
More Life.

A connected operating system where only your most important information gets in. One place to receive updates, track, coordinate, and ask questions. Bo was built to protect your time and energy.

Prioritize your health ❤️

Plan and track your nutrition and activity levels, get reminders for movement and hydration between your busy days.

Use Bo like Google ⚡️

Ask anything: recipes, prices, sports scores, directions, weather, restaurant picks, quick research.

Protect your time 🧘

Schedule events, get daily calendar previews, set reminders before calls, and clear your to-dos — all over text.

SECURITY BY DESIGN

Personalized AI,
enterprise-grade security.

Bo is built privacy-first. Your health data is encrypted by default, never sold, and never used to train public models. We maintain the highest standards so you can focus on your progress.

GDPR Compliant

HIPAA Ready

256-bit encryption

Data Privacy

FAQ

content_html_zh:
⭐

帮助节省 10 万+ 时间

Bo 让您的生活更轻松。 帮助您保持井井有条、节省时间、生活得更健康并回答您的问题——所有这些都通过短信进行。

交换了超过 2000 万条消息

使用案例

博让您的生活更轻松

营养与膳食

它是如何运作的

只需 4 步即可开始使用

STEP 1

机上

告诉 Bo 您的目标、身体和生活方式。

STEP 2

短信博

发送您的第一条消息 — Bo 在 iMessage 中回复。

STEP 3

连接集成

通过 Bo 应用程序同步您最喜爱的健康和生活方式应用程序。

STEP 4

探索技能

探索 Bo 满足您的健康和生活方式需求的能力。

会发生什么

更健康、更高效的生活方式

Why Bo?

问题

✕

您发现健康和生产力势不可挡

✕

您每月需要 1,000 美元以上才能聘请助理

✕

您每天在应用程序中浪费 1-2 小时的跟踪时间

✕

您努力实现目标并且无法坚持计划

解决方案

✓

Bo让您的生活更便捷

✓

Bo 是助理成本的 1/100

✓

Bo 在你已经所在的地方遇见你

✓

Bo 会来查看您的情况并 24/7 全天候待命

真正重要的是什么

您的生活质量

没有您的健康或时间，您将无法：

在体育和商业领域都发挥出最佳水平

专注于重要的事情，活在当下

成为精力充沛、风度翩翩、而不是疲惫不堪的合作伙伴

当您的身体无法跟上时，让记忆变得重要

与孩子一起积极活动，不要感觉自己错过了机会

#Live更多

更少的屏幕。 更多生活。

一个互联的操作系统，只有您最重要的信息才能进入。 一个接收更新、跟踪、协调和提问的地方。 Bo 旨在保护您的时间和精力。

健康优先❤️

计划并跟踪您的营养和活动水平，在忙碌的日子里获取运动和补充水分的提醒。

像 Google 一样使用 Bo ⚡️

询问任何问题：食谱、价格、体育比分、方向、天气、餐厅选择、快速研究。

保护你的时间🧘

安排活动、获取每日日历预览、在通话前设置提醒以及清除待办事项 - 全部通过文本进行。

安全设计

个性化AI，企业级安全。

Bo 以隐私为先。 您的健康数据默认加密，从未出售，也从未用于训练公共模型。 我们保持最高标准，以便您可以专注于自己的进步。

符合 GDPR

HIPAA 就绪

256位加密

数据隐私
